description:
App-Enabled E-Scooter: With Bluetooth-connected "EVERCROSS PRO" APP, riders can open/lock the sport scooters, control the cruise function, and can also know the speed and mileage of each ride, which can allow them to experience the electric scooter more conveniently through their phones.

Brushless Motor & Smart Battery System: With peak power 500W brushless motor, the electric scooter can reach to 19 MPH and climb slopes up to 10-15 degrees. High-quality battery (36V/12AH) has a maximum driving range of 22 miles under certain conditions and a maximum load of 330 lbs. (The above data may vary depending on riding conditions, rider weight, climate, and proper maintenance)

Safe & Comfortable Riding: The electric scooter for adults is equipped with 10-inch honeycomb solid tires, front and rear double shock absorption, turn signals and “Electronic Brake+Disc Brake” Technology, which will give you a smooth and comfortable riding experience even on bumpy roads.

Led Digital Display: The EV10K PRO E-Scooter is equipped with an intuitive LED digital dashboard, which can display the current mode, current speed, cruise control, bluetooth and headlight status. In addition, one button can complete all riding operations, very simple operation logic.

Foldable & Portable Design: The folding electric scooter can be folded down to the size of "43.3*20.1*21.3 inches", and the scooter adopts a simple and lightweight(35.3 LBS) design, so it is easy and convenient to carry and store in any place for students or office workers.
Note: The maximum speed of 19 MPH needs to be connected to the mobile APP to remove the speed limit or press power button 6 times in a row to upgrade the top speed of the electric scooter from 15 MPH to 19 MPH.
